bundle.shortDescription: One searchable overview of everything you own across the whole of Cairn.
bundle.longDescription: The Smuggler’s Ledger reads your own Grim Dawn saves — every character, every bag, every stash tab — resolves display names from your own local game install, and answers ‘where is my Ectoplasm’ without launching the game. Strictly read-only: the Ledger opens save files to read them and never for anything else. Zero configuration: it finds your saves and your install by itself.
